_README: The standing goals behind the morning text.
The machine can rank what is in front of it - who replied, what is
half-applied-for, who asked for a call. It cannot know what Harry is
trying to do with his life unless somebody writes it down. Left to
guess, a daily 'most productive action' text becomes generic hustle
advice, which is worse than no text at all.
So every line here came from something Harry actually said, or from
his CV, and 'source' records which. If a line is wrong, edit it - the
morning text is only ever as good as this file.
Live work always outranks a standing goal: somebody waiting on a reply
beats any of this. What is here fills the rest of the text, one at a
time on a rotation, so it reads as one thing to do today rather than a
'blocked_by' is the point of the ranking. The offshore tickets are not
one goal among five - they are the thing standing between him and the
market this entire machine searches, so they come first until they are

goals.goal: Get OPITO BOSIET and MIST paid for
goals.why: About GBP 1,000, effectively mandatory offshore, and the single thing keeping him out of the market this machine searches
goals.next_action: Ask on every call: Annie at Forces Employment, Cammy at TMM, and Cammach when they answer
goals.source: Told to Claude 2026-08-05; the same ask is already in every charity letter

goals.goal: Start the driving licence - provisional, then theory
goals.why: The scorer flags 'does not drive' as his one real constraint on where he can work, and every agency letter has to say it up front
goals.next_action: Apply for the provisional online, then book a theory test date
goals.source: CANDIDATE_PROFILE in job_machine.py, and the constraints paragraph in every agency letter

goals.goal: Ring one recruiter you have already emailed
goals.why: A consultant's direct line is the most valuable thing this machine finds and the one channel nobody should automate. Numbers are in the nightly digest
goals.next_action: Pick the top name off the call list and ring it before 10am
goals.source: Harvested from real reply signatures - Cammy Keith 01224 327030 among them

goals.goal: Move Leads2Profit forward by one concrete step
goals.why: Marketing automation for nightlife and events venues. It is on the CV and it is the thing that is his rather than somebody else's
goals.next_action: One outreach to a venue, or one improvement to the product - one, not a plan
goals.source: CANDIDATE_PROFILE: founder of Leads2Profit, marketing-automation for nightlife/events venues

goals.goal: Find out what it would take to restart the paused BEng
goals.why: Year 1 of Instrumentation, Measurement and Control at RGU is done and paused. Part-time or day-release changes what he can apply for in three years
goals.next_action: Email RGU admissions and ask what the paused year counts toward part-time
goals.source: CANDIDATE_PROFILE: Year 1 BEng Instrumentation, Measurement & Control at RGU (paused)

goals.goal: Touch the CV on the job boards you are registered with
goals.why: Most board databases rank search results by how recently a CV was updated, so a weekly touch puts him near the top of what recruiters see
goals.next_action: Re-upload or re-save the CV on CV-Library and Totaljobs
goals.source: README, the inbound section - it is why the alert accounts exist
